high_level_description: The image is an advertisement for Shell fuels, prominently displayed at what appears to be a gas station or fueling area. The top section of the image contains a yellow warning sign with various symbols and text indicating safety instructions. These include: A triangle with a flame inside, symbolizing fire hazards. A no-smoking symbol. A symbol indicating that the engine should be switched off. A prohibition against using mobile phones or sending SMS while refueling. A prohibition against sitting or straddling the fuel nozzle while refueling.
